threshold_source: User-approved contract in this task, plus clarification allowing <=1% isolated line omissions; systematic/region omissions fail. Recorded in intent.md section 8 and plan.md.

blocker.detail: OcrPage and TranscribedLine do not represent content class, note identity, marker spans, links or cross-page exception predictions. Gold-only validation cannot prove product semantic correctness. Implementing those outputs is not a measurement-only addition; ownership relative to deferred structure pipeline requires resolution.

measurement_audit.A: Existing NFC plus whitespace normalization in metrics.py; subgroup attribution for mixed-script lines still needs explicit operational definition. Do not reuse CGPG normalization removing footnote anchors.
measurement_audit.B: User clarified isolated omissions allowed up to 1%; existing box matcher is not independently evidence of nonempty correct line transcription.
measurement_audit.C: Native-control tau differs from existing pairwise accuracy. Pairwise accuracy is available in old harness, but matched-line and region coverage operational definition must be bound before evaluation.
measurement_audit.D: not_measurable_missing_prediction_fields; never treat absence as vacuous PASS or inject Gold labels into predictions.
measurement_audit.E: No two fresh dev runs performed; no stability claim.

holdout_policy: No frozen page inspection, inference, scoring or failure-directed tuning in this resumed task. Previous integrity-only preflight passed 16 pages/965 lines. No complete historical contamination certification.
